study.notes: STUDY: beta cell function and insulin sensitivity report of SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834), a 40 week multicentre randomised double blind placebo controlled parallel group trial of tirzepatide monotherapy 5, 10 or 15 mg once weekly versus volume matched placebo in type 2 diabetes, ITT efficacy analysis set 121, 121, 120 and 113. Table 2 prints the baseline and the change (or percent change) per arm with standard errors and, for each tirzepatide dose, the difference versus placebo with a 95 percent CI; those differences are the rows (route ci_95). Seven inventory markers are available at each of the three doses, 21 rows, and the pool keeps the highest dose per biomarker while the lower doses remain for a dose response analysis. Fasting glucose is an absolute difference in mg/dL and carries the Table 2 baselines as its denominator; the other six are percent changes and need none. Fasting proinsulin, the proinsulin to C-peptide ratio and IGFBP-2 are outside the inventory. The glucagon row is adjusted for fasting glucose, as the table states. This is the first placebo controlled GLP-1 and GIP dual agonist trial in the corpus to report the nutrient sensing panel, so it changes the class coverage for fasting insulin, C-peptide, glucagon, HOMA-IR and HOMA-beta. Eli Lilly sponsored (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall low | AUTHOR SUPPLIED FROM REGISTRY 2026-10-19: the capture for this row did not print an author. Europe PMC record for doi 10.1210/jendso/bvad056 (pmid 37153701) is 'Tirzepatide as Monotherapy Improved Markers of Beta-cell Function and Insulin Sensitivity in Type 2 Diabetes (SURPASS-1)', Lee CJ, Mao H, Thieu VT, Lando LF, Thomas MK, J Endocr Soc 2023. first_author is set to Lee on registry evidence, not from the capture. This is the beta cell function report of SURPASS-1, not the parent trial report, and the row's numbers come from it.

json.design: 40 week multicentre randomised double blind placebo controlled trial of tirzepatide monotherapy 5, 10 or 15 mg in type 2 diabetes, 478 randomised, ITT efficacy analysis set
json.reason: full text group (Europe PMC); seven inventory markers carry a difference versus placebo with a 95 percent CI at each of three doses
other_markers: HbA1c and body weight (reported in the primary publication)

rob.justification: randomised 1:1:1:1 through an interactive web response system and double blind with a volume matched placebo (D1 and D2 low); the ITT efficacy analysis set is reported with n per arm and the primary publication accounts for the flow (D3 low); central laboratory assays with standard errors on a mixed model (D4 low); these are secondary and exploratory beta cell endpoints of a trial powered for HbA1c (D5 some concerns)

doubts: the glucagon row is adjusted for fasting glucose, which is what the table reports; an unadjusted glucagon contrast is not printed
HOMA2-B is computed with C-peptide and HOMA2-IR with insulin, as the table states, so they are not the same estimator as the HOMA-IR rows of the older trials in the corpus
the authorship of the capture is not visible, so first_author is left for a verifier
pct_weight_change is empty: the weight contrast is in the primary SURPASS-1 publication, not in this report
